name: Bricking
definition: A method to handle volumetric data larger than GPU memory by dividing the original volume into smaller sub-volumes (bricks) that fit into GPU memory, rendering them individually, and composing the final image from these sub-images.
summary: Bricking is a memory management technique that subdivides large volumetric datasets into fixed-size bricks, enabling out-of-core rendering by treating GPU memory as a cache for on-demand loading.
